scope: Programmed controls exercise known branches; historical images demonstrate single-image processing. No sensitivity, specificity or water-quality accuracy claim.

checks.label: Image detail
checks.note: Low detail can be blur or naturally smooth water; retake before comparison.

checks.label: Exposure
checks.note: Very dark or saturated pixels hide visible detail.

checks.label: Bright reflections
checks.note: Bright, low-saturation pixels are a reflection proxy, not a water measurement.

checks.label: Selected area
checks.note: A useful selected area makes repeat comparisons less fragile.

comparison.reason: Views aligned using stable features outside the selected water area.
comparison.notice: Not calibrated water quality. Same-view appearance differences require contextual human review.
